risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to continuously evolving cybersecurity threats. Despite security measures in place, there is no guarantee these measures will be effective in preventing or limiting the impact of a security breach.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector. Competitors seek to increase market share and reduce costs. Private label brands continue to gain ground.

risks.title: Ingredient Regulation and Labeling
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to constantly evolving government regulations, particularly regarding labeling, food ingredients, and synthetic petroleum-based dyes. The FDA announced in April 2025 the phase-out of synthetic petroleum-based colorants, and the August 2025 MAHA report recommends additional restrictions.

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policy
risks.score_rationale: The company is directly exposed to tariffs affecting Canada, Mexico, and the EU. Tariffs impact ingredients, packaging (tinplate for canned goods), and finished products. Material financial impact expected in 2026.

risks.title: Cost Inflation and Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to inflation in raw material, energy, and transportation costs. In 2025, cost inflation was partially offset by productivity gains and cost savings initiatives. Upward trend expected in 2026 due to tariffs.

risks.title: Reputation and Product Quality
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to reputation risks related to quality issues, food safety concerns, or controversial ingredients in a changing regulatory environment.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its supply chain for raw materials and products. Vulnerable to supply disruptions, logistics congestion, and elevated transportation costs.
